```{r}
#| label: preview-packages
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: preview-load-data
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
shots_raw <- fread("data/shots_2025.csv",
                   select = c("arenaAdjustedXCord", "arenaAdjustedYCord",
                              "playerPositionThatDidEvent", "event"))
```

```{r}
#| label: preview-prepare-data
#| echo: false
shots <- shots_raw[
  event %in% c("SHOT", "GOAL") &
  playerPositionThatDidEvent %in% c("C", "D", "L", "R")
]

shots[, position_label := fcase(
  playerPositionThatDidEvent == "C", "Center",
  playerPositionThatDidEvent == "D", "Defense",
  playerPositionThatDidEvent == "L", "Left Wing",
  playerPositionThatDidEvent == "R", "Right Wing"
)]

set.seed(42)
shots_sample <- shots[sample(.N, max(1, floor(.N * 0.10)))]
```

```{r}
#| label: preview-shot-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5
pos_colors <- c("Center" = "#E74C3C", "Defense" = "#3498DB",
                 "Left Wing" = "#2ECC71", "Right Wing" = "#9B59B6")

rink_lines <- data.frame(
  x = c(-100, 100, 0, 0, 25, 25, -25, -25, 89, 89, -89, -89),
  xend = c(-100, 100, 0, 0, 25, 25, -25, -25, 89, 89, -89, -89),
  y = c(-42.5, -42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5),
  yend = c(42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5, -42.5, 42.5),
  color = c("#888", "#888", rep("#C0392B", 2), rep("#2980B9", 4), rep("#C0392B", 4)),
  linewidth = c(2, 2, rep(2.5, 2), rep(2.5, 4), rep(1.5, 4))
)

circle_path <- function(cx, cy, r, n = 100) {
  theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n)
  data.frame(x = cx + r * cos(theta), y = cy + r * sin(theta))
}

faceoff_top    <- circle_path(69, 22, 15)
faceoff_bot    <- circle_path(69, -22, 15)
faceoff_top_l  <- circle_path(-69, 22, 15)
faceoff_bot_l  <- circle_path(-69, -22, 15)
crease_r       <- circle_path(89, 0, 6)
crease_l       <- circle_path(-89, 0, 6)

ggplot() +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -100, xmax = 100, ymin = -42.5, ymax = 42.5),
            fill = "#DBE8F5", color = "#888", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_segment(data = rink_lines,
               aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend,
                   color = color, linewidth = linewidth),
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_linewidth_identity() +
  geom_polygon(data = faceoff_top, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = NA, color = "#C0392B", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_polygon(data = faceoff_bot, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = NA, color = "#C0392B", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_polygon(data = faceoff_top_l, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = NA, color = "#C0392B", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_polygon(data = faceoff_bot_l, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = NA, color = "#C0392B", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_polygon(data = crease_r, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = alpha("#2980B9", 0.08), color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_polygon(data = crease_l, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = alpha("#2980B9", 0.08), color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = shots_sample,
             aes(x = arenaAdjustedXCord, y = arenaAdjustedYCord, color = position_label),
             size = 1.2, alpha = 0.45) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors, name = "Position") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-100, 100), ylim = c(-55, 55)) +
  labs(title = "NHL Shot Positions — 2025 Season", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```
